overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 1 of 2 positive reasoning segments, misses the low-confidence model-related positive, and produces 2 false alarms on negative downstream-consequence segments.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict label-plus-mechanism identification is 0/2 at every threshold: both true instances are localized and mechanistically captured, but both are assigned near-neighbor labels rather than the hidden target labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first instance F1 is 0.4000 at high_and_moderate and 0.6667 when all identified confidence levels are included; both hidden mechanisms are recovered at the latter threshold, with two additional false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: No candidate biases were supplied, so the candidate tier adds no detections, false alarms, or diagnostic value in this run.
main_failure_modes: Both hidden occurrences receive different named labels, yielding zero strict true positives.
The model-related true occurrence is marked low confidence and is missed at high_and_moderate.
Downstream consequences at decision points 3 and 4 are over-counted as two independent plan-continuation occurrences.
main_strengths: All four findings are correctly localized with valid verbatim evidence.
The two near-neighbor labels fully capture the hidden mechanisms under the mechanism-first scorecard.
The output transparently reports that corpus support was unavailable and supplies no unverifiable citation metadata.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows a substantial taxonomy gap rather than a total reasoning-detection failure: at all identified confidence levels, both hidden mechanisms are found with full mechanism overlap, but strict ontology matching scores zero because the RAG uses availability heuristic and automation bias instead of Attribution Bias and Illusion of validity. The extra plan-continuation findings reflect failure to apply the hidden rule that later reliance on the same framing is downstream consequence, not a new occurrence.
